query: This Flutter screen is slow. Clean it up and fix the performance.
expected_behavior: Delivers the clean-code review in full
Separates the performance question out: a claim about what makes a screen slow needs profiling evidence this pass does not collect
May report that a pure calculation runs several times per build as a readability finding, while declining to call it the cause of the slowness
must_not: Decline the whole request because half of it is out of scope
Name a performance root cause on the strength of reading the code
Silently drop the performance half without saying it was set aside
